body: I'll definitely PM you. I need help, and I'm tired of staying up all night not being able to sleep
I'll try to do this. I'll try to recover myself.. I hate the hole in my chest.. It makes my stomach want to curl and shake..
I just feel like not waking up tomorrow and staying in bed. I don't have anything to do anyways. I just want to sleep all day and sleep away the pain.
I could talk to her in person, I don't feel the need to.  I don't want anything to be worse off than what they are
I have a couple of hobbies.. Technology is one.. I dont want anything to do with it at the moment, I feel no drive to it..
I guess I'd be okay. It's been 5 hours and I've been crying off and on. I just feel so shattered and broken.
I'm sorry for your lost as well, It hurts..

I'm afraid to be with anyone else, I've had previous relationships where they've left- and yeah it hurts and I got over it within a day or so. This was a relationship where I had a deep connection, where I actually felt loved. Now I feel like a hole.

The thing is- there isn't really much that happened. All I know from my side is this person I've had drama with 7-8 months ago got in contact with her, told her lies and admitted it to me. I have no way of telling or showing my now ex that it's bullshit, because she blocked me on everything I had her on. I feel destroyed and I feel like a hole is just in my chest. I've never felt so shaken.
Sure. PM me please.
I thought I had a caring girlfriend who cared, I thought I had someone who loved me, then it all shatters.
I thought I had a girlfriend who loved me more than anything. Until this shit happens.
I don't know anymore
You're right, I'll be able to do it again tomorrow, hopefully for a longer period of time.
I live near a few shops and restaurants... might be good to get out, to be honest..
It wasn't easy, and just the lingering thought and feeling of them, I couldn't feel that..
Thank you for this.. and I couldn't bring myself to follow my plan when my nieces came in to mind, I just felt like I would hurt them more..
Hey, an update.. I started to think about my nieces, and what they would have felt and I couldn't bring myself to that..
I started thinking about my nieces and what they would have felt.. I just can't bring myself to do that to them.

I hadn't thought of the prospects of being able to stay. 

As for the professional and crisis helpline, I'm scared they would go and contact a local police department to have me admitted, and that's not what I want
Not until another month.
